messages:
support: getting a big CS ticket — multiple customers seeing 503s from hosted inference since ~10:02 UTC. trace ids attached.
anya: reported same. spike in 5xxs and timeouts on /v1/generate around 10:01–10:06. QPS looked normal but error rate jumped.
michael: oncall alert showed ~45% 503s for the model-pool in us-west-2. oncall-bot: pager alert -> inference-upstream ERROR rate > 30% (10:02-10:05).
support: customer A (ticket #C-1179) saw repeated retries then duplicate billing events. they retried twice then got 500s. need quick mitigation.
devon: logs from one affected host: 
```
[2026-03-17T10:02:15Z] infer-runner[pid=3221]: cuda runtime error: out of memory
[2026-03-17T10:02:15Z] infer-runner[pid=3221]: segfault at 0 ip ... (stack: 0x7ffd...)
[2026-03-17T10:02:16Z] systemd: infer-runner exited with code 139, restarting container
```
michael: looks like OOM followed by SIGSEGV during cleanup path. same stack in three hosts. model in use: rdx-13b-quant, batch_size=8, max_tokens=2048.
anya: can we route traffic to dedicated fallback model (rdx-7b) while we triage? that should reduce mem pressure.
support: CS ok with fallback for now. they'd prefer minimal disruption.
devon: temporary mitigations I can do now: 1) enable fallback route to rdx-7b for hosted tier, 2) reduce batch size to 4 on affected pools, 3) increase restart backoff to avoid thrash and billing duplicates. ready to apply.
anya: deploy those changes and watch error rate. also add a 10s retry with jitter for the gateway so duplicate billing is less likely.
michael: quick note — we had a recent kernel update on those hosts two days ago (NVIDIA driver 535.x). need kernel+driver logs; tagging infra team.
james: repro steps if you want to reproduce locally: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rdx-13b-quant","batch_size":8,"contexts":["<~2k tokens of prompt..."]}' and run simultaneous 100 req/s for 30s. we hit OOM in ~20s.
devon: rolling the fallback now — enabling rdx-7b route for us-west-2, lowering batch_size on pool-42, increasing systemd backoff. will post when done.
oncall-bot: change set applied by devon at 10:08 UTC.
anya: error rate dropped to ~4% at 10:12 UTC. still seeing isolated restarts but no customer-impacting spike.
support: updated customer A: routing to smaller model and reducing retries. they acknowledged.
michael: next steps for RCA: collect coredumps, infer-runner logs, nvml logs, driver version, and the exact model binary used. need to test if quantized kernel path triggers allocator bug.
anya: create a follow-up page with repro artifacts + timeline. assign eng-runtime (devon) and eng-ml (michael).
james: note for billing team: duplicate charges likely from immediate client retries. recommend we issue credit for ticket C-1179 until we confirm dedupe.
support: filing billing credit request.
devon: opening an incident follow-up doc with logs and short repro (will attach coredumps). will also try forcing a CPU fallback in a canary to validate behaviour.
anya: thanks everyone. mark as triaged — continuing postmortem in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
